objective.interpretation_note: Accuracy and parsing are objective harness metrics. Explanation faithfulness requires completed reviewer annotations and is not inferred here.

atomic_consensus.interpretation_note: A primary model extracts and labels subject-matter claims. A secondary model independently labels the same fixed claims. Consensus unsupported means both judges flag a claim; possible unsupported means either judge flags it. Disagreements remain uncertain. This is automated, AI-assisted measurement and is not human-validated ground truth.
